title: Entropy v1.6: weighted epersistence + CI bands (v40,v41,v42)
abstract: Computes weighted avg eternitude_persistence (w=1/var) and produces CI tables + errorbar plot across v40–v42.

original_submission.content:
import sys, subprocess, shlex
SPEC40 = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v40_specimen.json'
SPEC41 = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v41_specimen.json'
SPEC42 = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json'
def main():
  rc1 = subprocess.call(shlex.split(
    f"python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/run_multi_specimen_v1_6.py {SPEC40} {SPEC41} {SPEC42} 600"
  ))
  print("RUN_MULTI_SPECIMEN_V16_RC", rc1)
  rc2 = subprocess.call(shlex.split(
    f"python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/plot_multi_specimen_v1_6.py {SPEC40} {SPEC41} {SPEC42}"
  ))
  print("PLOT_MULTI_SPECIMEN_V16_RC", rc2)
if __name__ == "__main__":
  main()
